origin: LinkedIn and Instagram image templates used overflow:hidden on fixed-height containers with hardcoded font sizes. Text clipping was silent — the PNG showed cut-off headlines with no error. Origin: repeated overflow bugs in clawcamp and cyborg-series campaigns (LinkedIn OG cards and Instagram carousel slides). Root cause: no mechanical check before PNG generation.
description: Detects text overflow in social media image HTML templates before PNG generation. Primary: Chrome headless JS DOM check. Fallback: static character-limit analysis against image-spec.json.
gates: chrome_overflow_check (primary): injects JS into temp HTML, runs Chrome --dump-dom, parses overflow report = BLOCK if elements overflow
static_char_check (fallback when Chrome unavailable): checks h1/subtitle text length against image-spec.json platform limits = WARN
depends_on: skills/social-distribution-engine/image-spec.json — platform char limits for static fallback
applies_to: Any HTML template about to be rendered to PNG via Chrome headless
SDE campaign asset generation — run before each platform PNG is finalized
Instagram carousel slides (overflow_risk: HIGH per image-spec.json)
litmus: Run HOW.py with html_file + dims — exit 0=clean, exit 1=overflow confirmed, exit 2=warn (static analysis or Chrome unavailable)
